source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher bibliographic record and Abstract, pp. 531–558
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article proposes a propensity-reweighted multisample U-statistic for observational treatment-effect heterogeneity, establishes asymptotic normality, and explicitly bypasses modeling the treatment effect for each subgroup.
The official publication metadata give the article as Annals of Statistics 53(1):295–321.

The paper studies Hölder-smooth CATE estimation and describes bounded-outcome conditions, but does not state the proposal's named uniform interior Bernoulli-mean condition 1/8≤μ_a≤7/8 as its standard model assumption.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the Dai and Kotekal bibliographic records, and describe Dai as a continuous observational heterogeneity U-test rather than a finite-stratum comparison.

Either remove the 1/8-to-7/8 arm-mean band from the headline class or retag it as a deliberately interior Bernoulli submodel with a concrete reason why its restriction is scientifically/materially necessary; then state whether the claimed frontier survives without it.

Add a proved-or-targeted specialization comparing the sharp radius to Yu's learner-remainder regime and Dhawan–Guo–Shah's direction-correlation condition, so the practical phase map yields an explicit non-subsumption result.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two inaccurate literature descriptions and resolve the nonstandard interior-mean restriction; the resulting same-class sharp testing frontier remains a field-tier Stage-0 target.
